runtimeRequirement.notes: PowerShell 7.4 or newer is required; live URLs must use HTTPS.

derivedFrom.guidance: Record the upstream template/version/digest and the provider's real API version. Specialize field normalization and bump evidence normalization before relying on provider-specific object shapes.

cursor.replay: The cursor covers source ID, field path, expected scalar, field presence, observed scalar, and match state. An unchanged response returns idle without advancing occurrence.
cursor.occurrence: Every committed changed observation increments state.occurrence. Event IDs include that value, so retries before commit retain an ID while a later recurrence receives a new ID.

semantics.terminal: This continuing condition template never returns terminal; remove or pause the watch when the condition no longer matters.
semantics.duplicates: Event IDs are deterministic from source ID, committed-state-derived occurrence, and normalized cursor. At-least-once retries before state commit repeat the same ID; recipients must deduplicate it.
semantics.changedIdle: A changed observation classified idle commits its new cursor and increments occurrence without emitting an event. That consumed occurrence prevents a later recurring event from reusing an older ID.

initialEmission.actionable: An already-matched scalar condition emits on the first attempt.
initialEmission.synthetic: This template has no synthetic snapshot event; emitInitialSnapshot is not a supported parameter.

semantics.diagnostics: Authentication, transport, parse, and configuration failures return schema-valid degraded results and write a structured detectorDiagnostic JSON record to stderr only.
semantics.classification: expectedValue must be a JSON scalar or null. A missing field never matches; an explicitly present JSON null matches expectedValue null.

credentials.policy: Use no authentication, bearer via HTTP_JSON_BEARER_TOKEN, or one named header via HTTP_JSON_HEADER_VALUE. Bearer and named-header modes are mutually exclusive.

provider.apiVersion: User-supplied JSON API; fixture shape v1

scheduling.maxSafeDowntimeRationale: A generic current-state endpoint may not retain transient condition history; five recommended intervals is the default safe gap until provider-specific evidence proves otherwise.
